comment: Which of a zone's layer filters (its LVB's layer sets, by ID) the client is told to show (ZoneInit's and ActorSetPos' transition_territory_filter_key), by quest progress. Retail's server picks it; the client's layout shows a layer only if its filter list has (or, for some, hasn't) that key, and with 0 in a zone like these every stage of the story stands there at once (Bob's Waking Sands screenshot, 2026-10-26). For each territory, the last entry whose quest has been accepted (and got as far as its sequence, if it has one) or completed applies (an entry without one is the default). Recorded: Bob's Chronofoil capture afe32479 visit 0.10 (2026-10-25), the Waking Sands during The Scions of the Seventh Dawn (509): 90338 in ZoneInit at its last step and in the ActorSetPos after it was completed; 90339 in the ActorSetPos as A Wild Rose by Any Other Name (510) was accepted, and after. Bob's Chronofoil capture b8432613 (2026-10-27): 90339 through Lord of the Inferno (343); 90340 in the ActorSetPos as A Hero in the Making (511) was accepted, and in ZoneInit to its end and The Company You Keep (Twin Adder, 680) being accepted; 90341 in ZoneInit once Wood's Will Be Done (683, the Twin Adders' next step; 684 and 685 are the other two companies': 685 the same in Bob's Chronofoil capture c99fe374 of 2026-10-28, 684 taken to be) was accepted; 90342 in the ActorSetPos as Sylph-management (513, which follows any of the three) was accepted. Back from the Wood (746): 90342 in ZoneInit with it at sequence 2, then 90343 in the ActorSetPos (warp type 18, after PrepareZoning to the same territory) as its Waking Sands cutscene moved it to 255, and 90343 at every later visit (Bob's Chronofoil captures 9df4ff01 and 3a705e18, 2026-10-30); an entry's "sequence" is how far its quest must have got. Wrath of the Titan (516): 90343 in ZoneInit before it, then 90344 in the ActorSetPos (warp type 18, where the player stood) as its accepting cutscene ended (Bob's Chronofoil capture 44df02fc, 2026-11-03). When the key changes within a visit, the server warps the player where they stand, as retail did (`ZoneConnection::refresh_layer_filter`).
